test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
V, W, X, Y, Z and A are six singers who have their concerts in different days of the same month, viz. 12th, 14th, 16th, 21st, 25th and 31st of July.

W has his concert on one of the days before X, but not on 21st. V has his concert on 14th. Only A has his concert after X. Y has his concert before V. Who has the concert on 21st of July?
solution:
Given: Six singers V, W, X, Y, Z, and A have their concerts on different days of the same month, viz. 12th, 14th, 16th, 21st, 25th, and 31st of July.

1) W has his concert on one of the days before X, but not on 21st.

2) V has his concert on 14th.

3) Only A has his concert after X.

4) Y has his concert before V.
